My dear Miss Yonge,
If I am not mistaken, you have issued lately several books.

Do you not think that there is one that would be suitable for republication in our [Series](/topic/224)?

If so, we should be glad to receive a copy, in order to judge how best to arrange our edition.
I sincerely wish that you may enjoy your usual good health and, hoping to receive your kind reply at your earliest convenience, I beg [you] to believe me,
with [my father’](/person/1396)s and my own best regards to you,
Yours very sincerely
[Tauchnitz](/person/2124)
